name: Empyrion - Galactic Survival
description: Space and planetary survival sandbox. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous); the server binary is a Windows executable.

variables.label: Game port (UDP)
variables.description: The server uses this port plus the four following ones (default 30000-30004).

notes: The install always fetches the Windows depot (platformOverride) — on Linux hosts run it with Wine/Proton (start command override: wine DedicatedServer/EmpyrionDedicated.exe ... with the same arguments). Saves land in Saves/ (SaveDirectory). Open UDP 30000-30004. The server has no stdin console; use the in-game admin tools or the optional telnet console (configurable in dedicated.yaml).
